evidence: Modifies src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp to properly test wallet coin selection behavior.
rationale: Fixes the SRD coin selection unit test to properly exercise weight-based eviction tie-breaking added in PR #33223. The existing test mistakenly passed `utxo_pool` instead of `mixed_weight_pool` and set a weight limit too high to trigger evictions, allowing regressions in tie-breaking to pass undetected.
